data.description: Found while building PQ-43 (PR #91, merged at 8098174). web/shared/trace.js renders the take-it-home step buttons as <button class="btn">, and web/home/home.css:64 sizes them (.walk .trace-nav .btn), but nothing in home's stylesheet chain (shared/tokens.css, shared/components.css, home/home.css) defines a .btn base rule: only web/host/host.css and web/buzzer/buzzer.css do. So on home those buttons get the browser's default button look, including its edge, which a11y.test.js does not check. PQ-43's owner ruling (2026-10-18) holds .btn edges at 3:1 (SC 1.4.11): --text-muted for neutral, --accent-hover for primary. Decide whether home's trace buttons get the same .btn rule (as host/buzzer carry it) and hold their edge in ac84_home; re-find line numbers first. Acceptance: just a11y and just test-web green; the edge check fails under its mutation; no copy or token value changes; AC-40, AC-33 hold.
data.title: Home's trace step buttons have no .btn base rule; the browser draws their edges
